ProjectSilverSquad.BrainChipDef.label: Cloning configuration disk
ProjectSilverSquad.BrainChipDef.description: A disk containing that can hold instructions readable by a cloning vat.\n\It can be slotted into the cloning vat to modify the characteristics of a clone.

ProjectSilverSquad.BrainChipDef.label: blank cloning configuration disk
ProjectSilverSquad.BrainChipDef.description: A disk containing that can hold instructions readable by a cloning vat.\n\nIt has the capacity of copying the data from other disks, to avoid losing the information.
